techParks.name: Helios Business Park

techParks.name: Exora Business Park

The geocoder resolved the neighbouring Cessna frontage, so the point is approximate and no bbox is given.

techParks.name: North Gate Business Park

Coordinates and bbox are the OSM Phase 2 polygon; Phases 1 and 3 sit immediately south and north.

techParks.name: EPIP Zone Whitefield

Point is the OSM Seetharampalya locality node; no polygon available offline.

techParks.name: Electronic City Phase 1

Point and bbox are the OSM Konappana Agrahara / Electronics City Phase 1 locality node.

techParks.name: Vaishnavi Tech Park

coverageNotes: Web-search budget for this run was exhausted midway (shared across 33 agents), so the second half of the lens was verified only through direct fetches of company sites, Wikipedia and aggregator pages plus offline OSM data. CONFIRMED FROM OFFICIAL PAGES (high where the building was geocoded exactly): Shadowfax, Ninjacart, Leap Scholar (4 offices), Teachmint, Pocket FM, Zolo, Portea, MFine (2), Ultraviolette HQ, Ultrahuman lab, Gameberry, Bombay Play, Scaler, Newton School, FreshToHome, LetsTransport, LoadShare, Vahak, Vegrow, Captain Fresh (2), Pratilipi, Third Wave Coffee, Oben, Eka.care, Onsurity, Niramai, Plum, Moonfrog, Simplilearn, Simple Energy (official contact page via search snippet; the domain did not resolve on fetch). AGGREGATOR/REGISTRY ONLY (medium): Yulu (Tracxn/Tofler/GST), HealthifyMe, Blowhorn, Furlenco, Rentomojo, Wakefit (listed-company filings), NoBroker, Nestaway, Masai, MPL, Even Healthcare, River Mobility, Bounce. LOW: Vahan (neighbourhood only), Loco (PIN only), Cuemath (official contact page now lists Gurugram, Bengaluru office unconfirmed), Dunzo and Koo (closed; building not published), Ultraviolette plant (only 'near Electronics City'), River's Hoskote plant, OSM-only second offices for Bounce, Rentomojo, Moonfrog, Scaler-Bellandur. NOT FOUND / LEFT OUT despite being Bengaluru-based: Locus (Mara Labs; site shows no India address), MediBuddy, Zivame, Bluestone, Mokobara, Hector Beverages (Paper Boat), Chai Point, Treebo, Colive, HomeLane and DesignCafe (only experience centres), FreshMenu, Dozee, CropIn, Headout (NY HQ, no Bengaluru address on site), Even Hospital and Even's six clinics (no addresses), Wakefit's two Bengaluru factories (addresses not published), Ultraviolette's 'Hangar' showroom. EXCLUDED AS NON-BENGALURU per the lens: Zypp (Delhi), Bijak, Otipy, Country Delight, Milk Basket, Blinkit, Pristyn, Noise, Mamaearth, Bombay Shaving, Urban Company, Stanza Living, Cars24, Spinny (all Gurugram), DeHaat (Patna), boAt (Delhi), Sugar (Mumbai), Classplus (Noida), Dream11, Games24x7, Kuku FM (Mumbai), Zupee (Gurugram), Rooter (Delhi), CarDekho (Jaipur), Bhanzu (official footer gives Hyderabad). SKIPPED AS COVERED BY LENS E07: Rapido, Ather, Porter, Jumbotail, Licious, BigBasket, Zepto, Cult.fit/Cure.fit, Practo, Vedantu, Unacademy, Byju's, Dailyhunt/Josh (VerSe), ShareChat/Moj, Swiggy Instamart (Swiggy). Companies named in the lens that turned out to be unicorns (NoBroker, MPL, Juspay, Captain Fresh at a reported ~$1.3 bn) are included with isUnicorn=true because the lens named them; Juspay is included because Namma Yatri sits inside it. Simplilearn is classed STARTUP (venture/PE-funded, founded 2010) though it could be argued MID_SIZE. Headcounts for Bengaluru specifically were not stated by any source, so bengaluruEmployeesApprox is null throughout. Hoskote (River's plant) lies inside the given lat/lng box (13.12, 77.83) and is included as a low-confidence industrial-area centroid. Tech-park entries cover only parks that host a company in this lens; single buildings (Carlton Towers, SJR The Hub, Vaishnavi Signature, Sona Towers, Umiya Emporium) are recorded on the office rows as 'building' rather than as parks.
